summary: Added completedTodos(todos) filter to src/todolist.mjs, wired a 'completed' CLI command printing done todos as <id>\t<title> in insertion order, added unit tests for the filter (order, non-mutation, empty), and documented 'Listing completed todos' in docs/product/todolist.md. Verified: node scripts/verify.mjs passes 12/12 (AC-1 covered by the completedTodos tests); manual CLI run in a temp dir shows 'completed' lists only done todos tab-separated in insertion order and 'list' still shows pending; pulse docs validate reports valid.
